Title: Unicorn & Dolphin Print Cotton Muslin Swaddle Set (2-Pack)
Body (HTML):
One side dreams in gold unicorns, the other dives with blue dolphins — two soft muslin swaddles that give your newborn a fresh print for every mood. Each piece measures 110 x 110cm in breathable cotton double-layer muslin, gentle against newborn skin and generous enough for a secure wrap.

Beyond swaddling, use either piece as a stroller cover, nursing cover, or lightweight blanket as your baby grows — soft, practical, and made to get softer with every wash.

Hand block-printed in Jaipur, one motif pressed at a time — small variations in the print are the mark of genuine handwork, not a flaw. Dyed with azo-free, skin-safe colours. A set of 2, ready to gift.
